About LDSTAR Africa

Building language skills for a connected world.

Who we are

Language skills for professional, academic and global life

LDSTAR Africa Language Centre is a language training institution dedicated to disseminating language knowledge and skills to professionals and members of academia.

We believe language is more than a subject of study. It is a practical skill that opens doors to professional growth, academic collaboration and meaningful connection across cultures. Our training brings together local, African and international languages, helping learners communicate with clarity and confidence in their work, studies and communities.

Guided by our vision of becoming a premier language institution in Africa, we offer training in global languages through both physical and online learning — so that learners can develop their skills in the way that suits them best.

  • Language knowledge

    A solid understanding of how a language works — its vocabulary, structure and use.

  • Professional development

    Language skills that strengthen communication in the workplace and support career growth.

  • Academic communication

    Confident language use for study, research, writing and scholarly collaboration.

  • African and global languages

    Training that brings together local, African and international languages.

  • Cultural and international engagement

    Greater understanding across cultures and stronger participation in a global society.

What guides us

Our Vision & Mission

Vision

To be a premier language institution in Africa offering training and skills in global languages.

Mission

To disseminate language knowledge and skills to professionals and members of academia.

Language programmes

Our Language Programmes

We offer training in seven language categories. Contact us to enquire about current training opportunities for any language.

English Hello

English is used widely in international business, diplomacy, science and higher education. Strong English communication supports professional writing, presentations, research and collaboration with colleagues around the world.

Enquire about English

Kiswahili Habari

Kiswahili is spoken by millions of people across East and Central Africa and is a working language of the African Union. Learning Kiswahili supports regional engagement, community work, cultural understanding and professional life across the region.

Enquire about Kiswahili

African Languages

Africa is home to a remarkable diversity of languages that carry history, identity and culture. Learning an African language deepens understanding of communities and opens new possibilities for research, development work and cultural exchange. Please contact us to enquire about the African languages currently available.

Enquire about African Languages

German Guten Tag

German is one of the most widely spoken languages in Europe and is closely associated with engineering, research, higher education and international trade. German language skills can support academic exchange, professional mobility and collaboration with German-speaking institutions.

Enquire about German

Spanish Hola

Spanish is spoken across Spain, Latin America and Equatorial Guinea, and is one of the most widely spoken languages in the world. It is valuable for international relations, tourism, trade and cultural exchange.

Enquire about Spanish

French Bonjour

French is widely spoken across West, Central and North Africa and is a working language of many international organisations. French language skills support regional collaboration, diplomacy, international development and academic exchange.

Enquire about French

Chinese 你好

Chinese is one of the world’s most widely spoken languages. With growing trade, investment and educational links between Africa and China, Chinese language skills are increasingly relevant for professionals, students and businesses.

Enquire about Chinese

How we deliver training

Two Ways to Learn

Learners can access LDSTAR Africa language training through physical, classroom-based sessions or through online learning.

In-person training

Physical Learning

Experience interactive, instructor-led language training in a collaborative learning environment.

  • Face-to-face, instructor-led sessions
  • Interactive speaking and listening practice with fellow learners
  • A focused, collaborative classroom environment

Remote training

Online Learning

Access language learning remotely through flexible online training and digital learning experiences.

  • Learn remotely, wherever you are
  • Flexible online training that fits around work and study
  • Digital learning experiences guided by instructors
